result.summary: Acknowledged SAVE-REPLAY-R01 version 2 (including the final encode-gate clarification) and authored a single new artifact, docs/validation/evidence/replay-checkpoint-2026-09-19/header.patch, containing a unified patch that touches only godot/scripts/core/save_header.gd. The patch: (1) moves the outer container to FORMAT_VERSION 2 with HEADER_BYTES 264 and SECTION_TABLE_OFFSET 264, leaving the CRC table's 256 entries and every other unrelated 256 untouched; (2) replaces OFFSET_REPLAY_SEQUENCE with OFFSET_ECONOMIC_NEXT_SEQUENCE_LOW=216, OFFSET_CHECKPOINT_RESERVED_ZERO=220, OFFSET_ECONOMIC_NEXT_SEQUENCE_HIGH=224 and moves OFFSET_BODY_DIGEST to 232, adding PREAMBLE_BYTES, CHECKPOINT_RESERVED_ZERO_BYTES and the terminal-pair constants; (3) removes Header.replay_sequence in favour of typed economic_next_sequence_low/economic_next_sequence_high/checkpoint_reserved_zero, updating the encode-word writer, the decode staging path and _copy_header, and deleting the old replay return/assignment lines rather than leaving a stale duplicate; (4) adds the two new codes REFUSE_SEQUENCE_RANGE and REFUSE_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH and reuses REFUSE_RESERVED_NONZERO for the offset-220 word; (5) adds preamble_refusal() with the exact 16-byte/magic/future>2/not-2 precedence, invoked by decode_header_into ahead of the 264-byte size gate; (6) reorders encode_header_into to destination-room, _version_refusal, digest lengths, generic widths, checkpoint tuple/padding, then staging copy, so no public writer can emit format 1 and refusals stay transactional; (7) stages and judges the checkpoint pair and reserved word before copying into the caller's Header, mapping an unreadable high u64 (sign bit included) to REFUSE_SEQUENCE_RANGE while every other u64 word keeps its existing refusal; (8) adds the pure header-owned predicate is_sequence_pair_valid() for ordinary u32 pairs or the terminal (2^32, 0) plus checkpoint_refusal(), with no section/scheduler/commands preload, and folds them into header_refusal(); (9) adds checkpoint_binding_refusal(header, section12_next_high, section12_next_low, section1_completed_tick) exactly as the contract states, with null/version/pair/padding/negative-tick precedence and a distinct mismatch code, validating binding only and performing no disk, store or clock work; (10) refreshes stale layout comments (header table, body-digest offset, body_offset 1224, section table at 264) while preserving the historical provenance and blocker annotations and claiming no full-file writer. Descriptor layout, CRC semantics, catalog-hash delegation and all other decode/hash semantics are unchanged; all new and changed APIs are typed and docstringed with no stubs or TODOs. Parent retains ownership of all tests, section 1 file-offset literals, commands.gd comments, registry/docs/queue/ledger updates. Nothing was executed, applied or verified by running anything.
